replacements.El coste real de un corte de suministro: The real cost of a supply outage is not the lost kWh
replacements.Las interrupciones tienen un coste que n: Interruptions carry a cost that does not appear on the electricity bill but does appear in the margins of every organization that bears it. And in healthcare the cost is not economic: it appears in clinical outcomes.
replacements.Generadores de respaldo, pérdida de prod: Backup generators, lost production and renegotiated orders. The gap relative to competitors with stable supply acts as a permanent implicit tax on competitiveness.
replacements.Sin capacidad de instalar generación de: Without the capacity to install its own backup generation. A prolonged outage can mean spoiled goods, cancelled customers and damaged machinery with no immediate recovery path.
replacements.Ruptura de cadena de frío de vacunas, ca: Breaks in vaccine cold chains, cancelled surgical procedures and perinatal mortality correlated with outage frequency. The cost is not measured in euros.
replacements.Fuente: Banco Mundial, Enterprise Survey: Source: World Bank, Enterprise Surveys. The 5–6% cost is the median for large firms in countries with unstable infrastructure; 20%+ represents the upper percentile for SMEs without their own generation.
